name: Sunny Watering Can
description: A cheerful low-poly watering can with a rounded lagoon-teal body, coral handle, curved mint spout, perforated yellow sprinkler rose, and a smiling flower badge.
use: Tilting the can pours a gentle spray of water from its perforated sprinkler rose.
author: Nadia
request: A watering can that sprays water when you use it
